name: dskit-consistent-kv-snapshot-export-and-restore
instr:
Give kv.Client users a portable way to capture one deterministic logical namespace and restore it across Consul, etcd, memberlist, and multi-store configurations. Snapshots must remain trustworthy under concurrent mutation, interruption, namespace translation, and backend migration. Existing KV operations must retain their current behavior.

Client.Snapshot returns a Snapshot containing SnapshotManifest metadata and a SnapshotReader of SnapshotEntry values with Key and Value fields, ordered lexicographically and bound to one stable logical image. Metadata identifies codec, namespace, count, and content, and Client.Restore validates it and the entire ordered stream before exposing successful completion or mutating for incompatibility; failures use ErrSnapshotIncompatible with "incompatible snapshot" or ErrSnapshotCorrupt with "corrupt snapshot" as appropriate. Cancellation promptly closes production, stops further work, returns the context error, and never reports completion, while interrupted valid restores return checkpoints that resume exactly once and are rejected for another artifact. Consul preserves index consistency and conditional conflicts, etcd preserves revision consistency and transaction limits, memberlist uses decoded values and normal merge propagation, and MultiClient pins its export primary and honors RestoreTargetPrimary or RestoreTargetAll. ConflictReject, ConflictPreserve, and ConflictReplace respectively reject unequal values, retain them while restoring
